topic: Paired Apple Watch missing iPhone app notifications: expected routing, delivery and quiet alerts

decisions: Two fresh harmless messages, with conversation closed and Watch at its face; compare iPhone unlocked versus locked, with Watch worn/unlocked. Do not reuse already-dismissed messages or assume notification duplication on both devices.

Decorative paired-device art and a text routing comparison; three symptom anchors, eight-section contents and native disclosures. No article JavaScript, notification permission request, message sending or new tracking.
Check nearby connection icons and radio settings before per-app preferences; watchOS 10+ side button versus watchOS 9-and-earlier gesture sourced explicitly.
Focus on both devices, per-app Mirror/Custom and Send to Notification Center versus alerting; temporary mute/Unmute explained. Missing preview content is separated from failed delivery.
Sound versus haptics, Silent/Theater Mode behavior and comfortable skin contact; automatic-volume feature qualified by watchOS 26 and supported SE 3/Series 9/Ultra 2-and-later hardware.

Result matrix narrows the next check without certifying hardware. Normal restart linked, off-charger Watch requirement noted, passcodes/work/update state preserved. Stop before unpair/erase; explain paired backup, Health/Fitness encryption and account/recovery planning.
No Watch repair capability invented: Apple handles persistent Watch issues; existing iPhone assessment link applies only to the paired phone’s hardware problem.

Official indexed source text used when direct Apple retrieval returned 429. Current UI version facts kept separate from older regional gestures. Remote-phone prerequisites linked for a separate branch instead of reproducing incomplete retrieved details.
Source-based organization attribution without invented device tests or expertise. Article/review dates November 1; no claim manufacturers updated sources today. Preserve hours and all unrelated work.
